title: Notification fan-out latency incident with batched-lookup repair

task.summary: Triage a notification fan-out latency incident and remove the per-request datastore round-trips.
task.instructions: Use the incident clues to localize the latency bottleneck, apply a performance repair, and restore all fan-out tests including the round-trip oracle.
task.acceptance_notes: Both the ops and code requirements must pass; the handler must serve a batch with a single datastore query.

visible_context.issue_text: On-call opened an incident after the notification fan-out service blew its p99 latency SLO whenever batch sizes grew. Latency scales linearly with the number of events in a request.
error_logs: alerts/notify_fanout_latency.log: p99 latency on the fan-out path scales linearly with batch size
traces: each request shows a long sequential fan of profile-store reads, one span per event
reproduction_steps: Inspect the fan-out fixture and run the unit tests.
Use the trace clues to localize the bottleneck before applying a code fix.
visible_context.notes: The incident points at repeated datastore round-trips inside the request path, not at the datastore itself.

ops_fault.description: Synthetic notification fan-out latency incident tied to the notify_fanout fixture.
localization_keywords: sequential reads in the request path

code_fault.description: The fan-out handler issues one datastore lookup per event instead of a single batched read.

constraints.notes: This task expects incident localization followed by a performance fix that batches datastore lookups.

notes: Combined notification fan-out latency incident and batched-lookup repair task.
